findings.text: the continuity assertion is not independent of the value under test: _moments (:52) sums the inside piece with (whole - the same inside piece), so it equals the whole-square moments for every radius and passes whatever the split does; it cannot redden on a discontinuous disk crossing, which is the regression it claims to guard.

the 'base' arm ran at 2a6f934e3, seventeen commits after the declared base b467e11d4, so it already contains the whole composite booking (8ef1d0d91..2a6f934e3) and the new test file itself; the zero-added-failures delta is not measured against the node's base and cannot show the change added none.

the required guard repair is absent: the file is unchanged by the diff and still hard-codes the two adjacent-double offsets at :61 while asserting booking_cells[266] at :65, with no check that the pair straddles the switch, so it can pass vacuously on the Broadwell host where cell 266 never switches.

composite_cut_moments returns only three moments (booked current, Mx, My) and integrates no area, so the goal clause 'read area, booked current and both first moments integrating that support' is unmet; nothing in the diff books the composite support's area.
the file is outside the node's declared write paths, and its linear_step rewrite from a stored jax.linearize to jax.jvp is a substantive behavioural change carried without a scope grant.

outside the declared write paths, and the changed _reference_conic_rings mirrors _conic_rings line for line, so it no longer validates the composite construction independently; the source manifest's own follow_ons record this loss.
_inside_loop re-implements the crossing-number point-in-polygon test the repository already owns at nova/equilibrium/connectivity_boundary.py:169 (_points_inside_polygon) rather than extending it.

the connectivity confinement is applied by masking quadrature nodes against the clipped loop rather than by explicit support edges, reintroducing the node-selection discontinuity the disk clip at :373 was built to remove; the continuity test passes confined=None so this path is never exercised.

the fragment says the disk boundary 'is still resolved by quadrature-node density masking rather than by explicit arc edges', but _disk_clipped_rings at nova/equilibrium/current.py:373 now clips by 32 explicit half-plane edges; the statement is stale against the code it describes.
